name: log_mid_ret_15s
hypothesis: Fastest-window (15s) signed mid momentum isolates the most recent directional impulse before averaging; tests continuation vs bid-ask-bounce reversion at 15-60s.

name: log_mid_ret_30s
hypothesis: 30s signed mid momentum sits between the 15s impulse and built-in 60s drift, long enough to drop single-snapshot bounce yet still one directional episode.

name: log_mid_ret_120s
hypothesis: Two-minute signed momentum reflects a multi-minute order program (rebalance/accumulation) that persists until filled, bridging fast 60s drift and slow state.

name: price_accel_60_180
hypothesis: Momentum acceleration (60s minus 180s log-mid momentum): positive = move speeding up (fresh info, continuation), negative = exhaustion (reversal risk); isolates persistence from direction.

name: rv_ratio_60_300
hypothesis: Vol acceleration ratio rv_60s/rv_300s: ratio >> 1 flags a variance burst (info arrival) that clusters and carries drift; a RELATIVE vol form, not the unsigned level that is library noise.

name: rv_ratio_z_300s
hypothesis: Trailing-300s z-score of the vol-acceleration ratio: flags variance accelerating far beyond this day's own recent regime (a clean regime-shift trigger), removing baseline and range.

name: signed_rv_60s
hypothesis: Trailing-60s net signed realized variance (sum sign(ret)*ret^2): which side the quadratic variation lives on; fast unnormalized cousin of the PASSed 900s rv_asym_300s.

name: last_mid_gap_ticks
hypothesis: Instantaneous aggressor side (last-mid)/tick: last>mid = buyer lifted ask, last<mid = seller hit bid; the fastest directional microstructure signal predicts 15-60s continuation.

name: last_mid_gap_ma_30s
hypothesis: Sustained aggressor direction: trailing-30s mean of the signed gap aggregates consistent buyer/seller aggression (magnitude-weighted), flagging informed flow not yet absorbed.

name: aggressor_share_60s
hypothesis: Aggressor consistency: trailing-60s net frequency of buyer- vs seller-initiated snapshots (sign-only, robust to size); repeated same-side aggression is the footprint of informed accumulation.

name: spread_z_60s
hypothesis: Fast liquidity-state shift: quoted spread wide vs its own trailing-60s distribution flags immediate quoting stress/adverse selection, reacting faster than the built-in 300s z.

name: spread_z_120s
hypothesis: Mid-horizon liquidity state: trailing-120s spread z flags widening sustained beyond one burst but not yet absorbed into the 300s baseline, a persistent adverse-selection regime.

name: mid_day_range_pos
hypothesis: Position within the intraday high-low range (causal cum_max/cum_min): proximity to day extremes encodes anchoring and resting stop clusters, predicting breakout/rejection at those zones.

name: vol_adj_mom_60s
hypothesis: Momentum quality: 60s log-mid momentum divided by sqrt(rv_60s) is a per-minute Sharpe; steady low-var drift = persistent informed flow (continues), choppy same-size move = noise (reverts).

name: rv_z_300s
hypothesis: Vol regime-shift trigger: trailing-300s z of rv_300s measures how far current five-minute variance sits vs its own recent distribution (relative form), which clusters and carries drift.
